protocol: parallel-run protocol (lane / reuse / evidence class / leakage canary / run card / budget)
hypothesis: Blind geothermal systems in the northern Great Basin localize at dilatational fault step-overs, intersections and relay ramps that lie OFF the mapped USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue traces; the catalogue maps traces but not blind tips, buried jogs or unmapped splays, so an off-catalogue structural field targets faults missing from the catalogue.
mechanism: Catalogue-geometry-only field built from existing_faults.tif: exponential off-trace decay halo exp(-d_cat/3 px) on the 100 m grid (300 m scale), catalogue pixels masked pixel-exactly to zero, multiplied by multi-scale junction/step-over excess density (fault density in a 2.1 km window minus the same in a 1.1 km window, floored at zero), restricted to the scored footprint and normalized to [0, 1]; the top 37,654 allowed cells are emitted as binary dots. DTI notation (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel) matches the competition metric; no labels and no model are used.
named_non_fault_mimic: Piedmont / range-front alluvial topography or volcanic-center alteration can produce junction-like lineament patterns without a fault; the geometry-only field carries no radiometric/topo training signal, so there is no label-leakage route by construction, but this non-fault process remains the alternative explanation.
differ_from_repo: No 19-band fit, no logistic/HGB model, no dot-budget sweep, no submodular / SAR / phase-congruency machinery — pure public catalogue geometry with off-trace masking at equal 37,654-dot budget; distinct from every executed GEMSDOE86 lane.

No HOLDOUT-DTI number is reported or projected; nothing here is a leaderboard projection or score.
